summary: An Anthropic employee announced on X the launch of a new model, Claude Fable 5.1, describing it as built for autonomous multi-step work with improvements in coding, knowledge work and long-running problem-solving.

practices.reason: The post claims a new model version improves coding, knowledge work and long-running autonomous task performance, but gives no benchmark or figure to act on.
practices.quote: Fable 5.1 sets a new standard across coding, knowledge work, and long-running problem-solving tasks.
